facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2011-0179 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 17 December 2011 as a scheduled change under change request; no event precedes it in the record. The change request record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the critical safeguard named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are PRO-HSE-005 and STD-HTW-004.
